Personal care and cosmetics

Agricultural formulations

Packaging research

Review cellulose-containing coatings and interfaces as an emerging research area. Substrate, humidity, converting conditions and the full material structure determine what needs to be measured. Packaging research ↗

Tell NeoNaar which formulation or substrate you use, what behaviour needs to improve, how the material will be applied and which evidence you need to make a procurement decision. Sample availability and relevant technical information can then be discussed against that brief.
